critique.evidence: Keyboard coverage and visible focus pass for every expected header and thesis control at all viewports; no touch-target violations were measured; reduced-motion produces zero active animations or changed elements; and no uncontained viewport overflow was found. However, WCAG contrast remains unresolved: axe reports serious color-contrast incompletes on thesis text/verdict elements at desktop and tablet and on header links at tablet/mobile. Mobile thesis content also has a 435px scroll width within a 390px section, even though the measured excess is clipped decoration.
critique.fix: Provide measured contrast ratios for every unresolved text state against its actual composited background and adjust colors to WCAG AA where needed. Remove the mobile section’s excess scroll width by containing the decorative inset without enlarging the scroll box, then rerun axe, keyboard, touch-target, overflow, and reduced-motion checks.
